note: Generic cold-start pick-and-place menu over honest LIBERO signals (proprioception, finger contact flags, Astra keypoints). No task-specific constants; no grasp verification, placement correction or retry rules yet (left to RSI).
intent_instructions: Choose from current facts rather than following the menu blindly. When release_ready is true, select open_gripper immediately. After open_gripper select retreat. After retreat, if the episode continues and camera budget remains, select relook before considering finish; use refreshed estimates to retry a misplaced object. Opening during reopen_and_retry is a grasp retry, not completed placement. For acquisition, prioritize close_gripper when at_grasp is true and the gripper is open. After descend_to_grasp, continue descending if still aligned and not at_grasp; losing above_grasp during descent is expected and does not require moving upward. Repeated unsuccessful descents warrant relook within the camera budget. After closing, both finger contacts justify a trial lift even when seen_held is false from an earlier look. After lifting, check current finger contacts before carrying. A nearly shut gripper with neither finger contacting indicates an empty grasp; select reopen_and_retry and refresh perception before another descent when camera budget remains. A narrow opening with both contacts can still be a valid grasp. Use relook for ambiguous contact evidence, not merely for an old seen_held value. Once above_place with both contacts, lower until release_ready and then open; do not restart lift merely because lifted becomes false during lowering. Never infer task success solely from release or retreat. Respect the camera budget and bound grasp retries; finish is an exhausted-attempt stop when further recovery is unavailable.

intents.name: move_above_object
intents.definition: Gripper open and not above_grasp: move above the estimated grasp point.

intents.name: descend_to_grasp
intents.definition: above_grasp is true and at_grasp is false, gripper open: descend to the grasp point.

intents.name: close_gripper
intents.definition: at_grasp is true and the gripper is open: close the fingers.

intents.name: lift
intents.definition: Gripper closed on the object and not lifted: raise vertically.

intents.name: carry_to_place
intents.definition: lifted is true and above_place is false: carry the held object above the place point.
intents.refpoint: vec(place[0] + grasp[0] - objc[0], place[1] + grasp[1] - objc[1], tcp[2])

intents.name: lower_to_place
intents.definition: Gripper closed with both finger contacts and above_place true, but release_ready false: lower vertically while preserving the grasp; becoming lower than the transport height does not require lifting again.
intents.refpoint: vec(tcp[0], tcp[1], place[2] + min(max(clear, 0), 0.2*obj_h) + tcp_at_close[2] - objc[2] + obj_h)
intents.evidence: Repeated lowering was followed by camera-driven target changes and renewed transport; several releases also occurred substantially above the estimated support.

intents.name: open_gripper
intents.definition: The object has been lowered over the place point: open the fingers to release.

intents.name: retreat
intents.definition: released_since_close is true: raise the empty gripper.

intents.name: reopen_and_retry
intents.definition: The grasp failed (gripper closed but the object is not held): open and go back above the grasp point.

intents.name: relook
intents.definition: Ask the camera perception module to look again and refresh object/place estimates and whether the object is held.

intents.name: finish
intents.definition: The object was released at the place and the gripper retreated: stop.

predicates.name: above_grasp
predicates.expr: dist_xy(tcp, grasp) < 0.3*obj_h and tcp[2] > grasp[2] + obj_h
predicates.meaning: gripper is roughly above the grasp point

predicates.name: at_grasp
predicates.expr: dist_xy(tcp, grasp) < max(0.2*obj_h, 0.1*open_max) and abs(tcp[2] - grasp[2]) < max(0.25*obj_h, 0.2*open_max)
predicates.meaning: gripper is aligned with the grasp and close enough vertically to attempt closing

predicates.name: lifted
predicates.meaning: closed gripper is raised well above grasp and place heights

predicates.name: above_place
predicates.expr: dist_xy(vec(tcp[0] - grasp[0] + objc[0], tcp[1] - grasp[1] + objc[1], 0), place) < 0.3*obj_h
predicates.meaning: held object is roughly above the place point

predicates.name: release_ready
predicates.expr: closed_cmd and above_place and abs(tcp[2] - (place[2] + min(max(clear, 0), 0.2*obj_h) + tcp_at_close[2] - objc[2] + obj_h)) < max(0.1*obj_h, 0.05*open_max)
predicates.meaning: closed gripper is aligned over the target and has reached the commanded release height; select open_gripper
